Samir: Quick sync — blackbox heartbeat sampler for embeddings in eu-central1 started spiking around 03/03 02:10UTC. Failures are mostly RST_STREAM / 503 during scale-ups. Anyone else seeing this? https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd

Maria: Yep saw the dash. 5xx rate up to 6% for embedding endpoint. TCP handshake and short TLS errors around the same time. Are probes going to dedicated pools?

Eli: They route to dedicated-gpu-pool-3 in eu-central. Logs show a bunch of connection resets with this pattern:
```
[2026-03-03T02:11:02Z] conn_id=3214 RST_STREAM: code=8 ALPN=h2
[2026-03-03T02:11:02Z] backend=dedicated-gpu-3 node=gpu-3-7 latency=120ms
```

Jun: Recreated locally with curl (http2) got `RST_STREAM 8`. Probe config uses `--http2` and high concurrency (60). Maybe ALPN negotiation race when new GPU instances join.

ops-bot: ALERT blackbox-eu-central-embedding-5xx - fired (window=15m, value=0.058) — alerts/oncall

Samir: Proposed mitigations:
- drop probe concurrency from 60 -> 12
- add random jitter (0-300ms) and stagger start times
- temporarily reduce embeddings probe sampling to 1% during autoscale windows
I'll open a PR for probe-config change and canary in eu-central.

Maria: Also tweak Prometheus alert expr to `sum(rate(blackbox_http_responses_total{code=~\"5..\",job=\"blackbox\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(blackbox_http_requests_total{job=\"blackbox\"}[5m])) > 0.03` and add label-based suppression when `autoscaler.state` == "scaling_up". Use 5m window and 3% threshold to reduce noise.

Eli: I'll roll the canary in 10m to just the eu-central probe set. Watching SLO dash and `blackbox_request_latency_seconds_bucket`.

Jun: FYI cost impact: embeddings probes at current rate cost ~0.9 GPU-hours equivalent per day in eu racks. Sampling to 1% during scale windows cuts token cost ~70% — added note to runbook.

Samir: Thanks. @ops-bot suppress pager for 30m while canary runs.

ops-bot: Pager suppressed for 30m by Samir. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Keeping thread here — will post PR link and canary results.
